items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: Fletcher Henderson taught me those basic fundamentals... he showed me in about two or three days what I'd been trying to learn in four or five years. How to voice properly for orchestration.

ctx.x: I copied music for Benny Goodman when he was writing -- for Fletcher Henderson when he was writing for Benny Goodman. He was living in the Dunbar Hotel, and he is the one that showed me in about two or three days what I'd been trying to learn in four or five years. How to voice properly for orchestration. I had tried to learn by listening, I had listened to Count Basie's band, all these other writers who had this -- they had different styles, and it was about this time they came out with the famous Schillinger…
You know, in other words you know that this note is supposed to be in the chord --
